description: This Java source file defines the HibernateAdministrationDAO class, which provides Hibernate-specific implementations of database operations for the AdministrationService in the OpenMRS framework. It includes methods for managing global properties, executing SQL, validating entities, and updating PostgreSQL sequences.

classes.name: HibernateAdministrationDAO
classes.description: Hibernate-specific DAO implementation for administrative database operations in OpenMRS, including property retrieval, SQL execution, validation, and sequence updates.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory used for database interactions.

methods.name: getGlobalProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a global property by name.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyObject
methods.description: Fetches the GlobalProperty object for a given property name, considering case sensitivity.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a GlobalProperty by its UUID.

methods.name: getAllGlobalProperties
methods.description: Retrieves all global properties sorted by property name.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertiesByPrefix
methods.description: Finds global properties whose names start with a specified prefix.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertiesBySuffix
methods.description: Finds global properties whose names end with a specified suffix.

methods.name: saveGlobalProperty
methods.description: Saves or updates a GlobalProperty in the database.

methods.name: executeSQL
methods.description: Executes a raw SQL query, with optional select-only behavior.

methods.name: getMaximumPropertyLength
methods.description: Determines the maximum length of a specified property field for a given class.

methods.name: setApplicationContext
methods.description: Sets the Spring application context, retrieving Hibernate metadata.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates an entity object against Hibernate mappings and custom validators, checking field lengths and compliance.

methods.name: getValidators
methods.description: Fetches registered validators applicable to the specified object.

methods.name: isDatabaseStringComparisonCaseSensitive
methods.description: Checks whether database string comparisons are case sensitive, based on a global property.

methods.name: updatePostgresSequence
methods.description: Updates PostgreSQL sequences after data insertion to ensure sequence values are in sync with table maximum IDs.
